anatomical_frames.head: Level skull longitudinal axis; pose pitch applied after construction. Keep jaw tooth bed in its own smooth bite frame.
anatomical_frames.body: Use Clay skeletal/muscle architecture and the corrected shared NightWing construction methods; retain thorax, shoulder and haunch volume. Slim is a change of degree, not missing musculature.
anatomical_frames.wing_order: Two forewings plus two smaller hindwings. Separate shoulder attachments and fan domains, each on actual articulated supports.

skull.primary_mass: Long low rounded wedge with a supported cranial vault, tapered nasal bridge and rounded U-shaped anterior footprint.
skull.differences_from_nightwing: Cover shows a blunt-rounded, subtly raised nasal tip, not Moon's eagle hook or Clay's broad square muzzle. Orbital rim must not become the whole roof.
skull.hidden_width: Retain cranial breadth relative to head length from Clay until top/front SilkWing evidence constrains the delta. A side image cannot establish width.
skull.mouth: Reuse smooth bite-frame fitting, seated upper/lower dental arcs, tongue clearance and deforming cheek method; rebuild against SilkWing host rather than transplanting Moon's finished mouth coordinates.

horns_and_antennae.horns: Long slender swept, plated horns seated in cranial housings; stronger backward curve than Moon.
horns_and_antennae.antennae: Distinct pair from brow above eyes, forward/dorsal to horn bases, long flexible furling tips. Do not treat four appendages as horns.

neck_and_torso.shape: Long S-curve neck into deep shoulder keel and narrow waist; continuous rounded body with no pinched throat or weak cylindrical legs.
neck_and_torso.muscles: Retarget Clay origin/insertion profiles, preserve volume through each joint, reduce breadth and bulk in measured amounts.
neck_and_torso.feet: Reuse articulated Clay digit/claw organization at proportionate scale; do not bind all toe segments to one foot bone.

wings.digit_counts_status: Side-image trace distinguishes distal arches from the arm-bend free hook. The earlier four-ray upper fan / two full-length lower spokes misread those roles.
wings.structure: Muscular arms with elbow, wrist and finger knuckles. Rounded continuous membranes on supported fans, not rigid oval butterfly cards and no additional leftover MudWing wings.
wings.resting_fold: Unresolved: cover is open/airborne; How to Draw crop is wingless. Need actual folded SilkWing evidence. Any provisional rest rig must preserve segment lengths, fan ordering, compact gathering and outward cupping.
wings.attachment_contract: Trace the trailing shoulder-elbow-wrist chain, with no shoulder-to-wrist chord or leading-side fill triangle. Arm tissue, body web and digit panels share sampled boundaries and identical weights; release into membrane weights smoothly behind the arm. Test all folds and stroke rotations.

surface.palette: Textual azure/morpho blue, lavender/violet back and arms, purple snout, cerulean wings with purple/blue shimmer; cover lighting shifts some surfaces green.
surface.scales: Gem-like plated scale flow, smaller dorsal spines, continuous belly under throat/jaw. Color differences follow actual fitted surfaces, not a global height cutoff.
surface.flamesilk: Small wrist glands/glow, not fire breath. Palm marking can be a later fine detail after anatomy.

size.maturity: Wings develop around six; rapid juvenile growth is well advanced. Do not use 6/7 as a linear size multiplier.
canon_comparisons: Larger than Cricket in the book-cited description; that does not establish larger than Moon or an absolute height.
size.reason: No verified numeric character dimensions. Keep the current gameplay scale provisional until the rebuilt mesh and comparisons exist.

construction_order: Head/skull/bite on level anatomical frames; check front and top, not only profile
Full continuous neck/trunk with retargeted Clay muscle and digit architecture
Forewing 4-ray and hindwing 2-ray skeleton, supported outlines, joined attachment topology
Fold and spread through shared movement pipeline, then surface scales/color
Actual game checks: standing contacts, walk/run/jump/climb, ascent power and descent glide; inspect all-angle shape and mouth/blink
acceptance: No flat anterior cap in top/front views; rounded nasal footprint and distinct SilkWing profile
No head/body disproportion or twig neck
No floating horn roots, antenna bases or wrist claws
No eyelid/globe exposure on closed blink, tongue/jaw intersections or rear oral curtain
No membrane gaps at arm, web or articulated fingers at intermediate folds
No removed or duplicated MudWing wings; exactly four anatomically supported wings
Same Clay movement components, scaled from measured bone lengths; no copied animation loop
No leading-side membrane sail during retraction; wing web follows the back of the actual arm chain

reference_landmarks.status: Initial manual landmark picks, roughly +/-8 px; no pixel-perfect trace claimed

anatomical_frame.note: Frame built from explicit orbital/nasal landmarks; build skull level in this frame before applying the pictured downward pitch.

reference_landmarks.lip_note: Visible lip contour only. Must not become a zigzag tooth-bearing jaw plane. Hidden dentary is reconstructed in a smooth shared bite frame.
reference_landmarks.proportion_note: The tribe sheet is oblique; these coordinates constrain profile and attachment arrangement, not skull width or world limb lengths.
